title: The Crystal That Vanished Overnight: The Ritonavir Crisis
summary: A translation of the same day's science episode: one and the same molecule can adopt different crystal arrangements (polymorphs), and in nineteen ninety-eight a second, more stable form suddenly appeared on the production line of the HIV drug ritonavir, leaving the original form impossible to make again. It covers the hypothesis that microscopic seed crystals contaminated the whole facility, Ostwald's rule, and how between twenty twenty-two and twenty twenty-four the vanished form was brought back through mill grinding, melt, and the choice of solvent.
